changes.current_line: Recover failed payments automatically with smart retries.
changes.change: For subscription fitness buyers, lead with: "Win back the members who never meant to leave." Present recovery as a cut to the churn number they already report to their board, then prove it by running a free analysis on a one-month export of the prospect's own failed renewals. The analysis should show which ones usually come back with a retry or an updated card. Offer it before the paper goes to finance.
changes.why: The deal started as a board-level churn problem, the customer's own phrase for it was "members who never meant to leave", and the contract was signed four days after recovery was shown on their own failed-renewals file.

changes.current_line: Proven ROI, backed by an independent economic impact study.
changes.change: Give the finance signer (controller) a business case built on the prospect's own numbers: a spreadsheet of their failed renewals with the share we expect to recover, which they can take away. Use the independent study only as backup, not as the lead proof.
changes.why: The contract sat with the controller for two weeks and moved only after he asked for the spreadsheet of his company's own data; his signature is on it.

changes.current_line: Online and in-store on one platform; the line between them has pretty much disappeared.
changes.change: Don't lead with unified commerce where the in-store piece runs through a partner integration we can't show live in the customer's own studio software. Say plainly that front desk is a partner path, offer a staged plan (billing first, front desk later), and describe front-desk impact in terms of staff workflow. Promise a single-screen front-desk flow only once we can demo it in their setup.
changes.why: The customer heard our unified-commerce framing as "is that the readers?", which pulled the evaluation toward a front-desk demo we couldn't show live and left the studios with the incumbent.

changes.current_line: Financial infrastructure to grow globally, in every currency.
changes.change: Don't open with the global positioning line for subscription fitness buyers. Open with failed-renewal recovery on their own data instead.
changes.why: The rep opened with the global slide and got silence.
